result:
Section 4 (Health/HealthKit) is implemented and verified working end-to-end on the iOS Simulator.

**Changes:**
- `App_Resources/iOS/app.entitlements` (new) — HealthKit entitlement
- `App_Resources/iOS/Info.plist` — added `NSHealthShareUsageDescription`/`NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription`
- `types/references.d.ts` — added a reference to the HealthKit type declarations (not pulled in by the default iOS type bundle)
- `app/components/Health.vue` — wired to `HKHealthStore` directly (write-authorization status, request access, save 500-step samples, query/bucket the last 7 days)

**Verified on simulator (via idb taps + screenshots):**
- Auth status line reads exactly per spec in all three states (not requested / granted / denied)
- `Log 500 Steps` disabled until granted; tapping it live-updates today's total with thousands separators (1,000 → 1,500) and bold `(today)` row
- Denied state disables logging and shows `Health access needed`, no crash on any interaction
- Data and authorization persist across relaunch

`ns build ios` and `vue-tsc --noEmit` both pass cleanly.
